description: This file provides utility functions for managing CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) sessions using Playwright. It includes functions to create session contexts for a page and to execute code within a page-scoped CDP client.

methods.name: async function withPlaywrightPageCdpSession<T>( withPlaywrightPageCdpSession
methods.description: Creates a Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) session for a given Playwright page and executes a callback function within that session. Ensures the session is detached afterwards.

methods.name: export async function withPageScopedCdpClient<T>(opts: { withPageScopedCdpClient
methods.description: Sets up a CDP client within a specific page context based on provided options, and executes a callback function with a send method to communicate via CDP.
